_meta: Source of truth for which ai/hooks/*.sh are registered in ~/.claude/settings.json, and on which event/matcher. `ai/bin/check-hooks-registered` asserts these are live (drift is the bug that silently disabled safe-wait-guard + pronoun-guard on 2026-09-17); `scripts/setup-hooks --install` writes them by MERGING (never clobbering the existing block — the clobber is what caused the outage). Paths are repo-relative and expanded to absolute against this repo's location. Matchers are Claude Code tool-name regexes; "" matches all (used for non-tool events).
